scripts.setup: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm seed && pnpm sandbox:build
scripts.sandbox:build: docker build --target base -t codechatter-sandbox:dev -f sandbox/image/Dockerfile sandbox && pnpm docker:tidy
scripts.sandbox:build:full: docker build --target full -t codechatter-sandbox:full -f sandbox/image/Dockerfile sandbox && pnpm docker:tidy
scripts.docker:tidy: docker image prune -f --filter label=codechatter.sandbox=1 && docker builder prune -f --keep-storage 10gb
scripts.k8s:images: docker build -f infra/docker/app.Dockerfile --target migrate -t codechatter-migrate . && docker build -f infra/docker/app.Dockerfile --target api -t codechatter-api . && docker build -f infra/docker/app.Dockerfile --target collab -t codechatter-collab . && docker build -f infra/docker/app.Dockerfile --target runner -t codechatter-runner . && docker build -f infra/docker/app.Dockerfile --target web -t codechatter-web . && pnpm docker:tidy
